{{short description|German chemist and nuclear whistleblower (born 1950)}}
[[File:Moormann rainer 04.jpg|thumb|Rainer Moormann ]]

'''Rainer Moormann''' (born 1950) is a German [[chemist]] and [[Nuclear whistleblowers|nuclear whistleblower]]. 

== Whistleblower award ==
For doing this despite the occupational disadvantages he had to accept as a consequence,{{which?|reason=Seems like the guy I'd want to hire if I was competing with whoever he blew the whistle on (believe it or not you do want extremely safety-minded people on these types of projects, which is why we've had as few accidents as we've had), but that's probably why I'm not a nuclear engineer, which at least in Japan seems to involve shouting, "it'll be fine in the severe tsunami zone", and later, "just dump it in the ocean!"|date=October 2026}} Moormann was awarded the whistleblower award of the [[Federation of German Scientists]] (VDW)<ref>[http://www.vdw-ev.de/images/stories/vdwdokumente/aktuelles/whistleblowerpreis%202011%20begrndung%20kurz.pdf Press statement of the VWD (in German)]{{dead link|date=April 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}, official short version in English: http://ialana.net/uploads/media/Program_Whistleblower_Award_2011.pdf, unofficial English translation of the press release: https://euzicasa.wordpress.com/2011/06/10/presentation-of-whistleblower-award-2011_via-hintergrund/</ref> and of the German section of the [[International Association of Lawyers against Nuclear Arms]] (IALANA).

== Papers ==
In 2020, Moormann co-authored a paper that argued in favor of keeping the available six German nuclear power plants running in order to reduce {{CO2}} emissions.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Appunn |first=Kerstine |date=2021-12-28 |title=Q&A: Why is Germany phasing out nuclear power and why now? |url=https://www.cleanenergywire.org/news/qa-why-germany-phasing-out-nuclear-power-and-why-now |access-date=2022-09-06 |website=Clean Energy Wire |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Moormann |first1=Rainer |last2=Wendland |first2=Anna Veronika |date=2020-07-15 |title=Stoppt den Atomausstieg! |url=https://www.zeit.de/2020/30/deutsche-klimastrategie-atomausstieg-co2-emissionen-bundesregierung |url-access=subscription |trans-title=Stop the nuclear phase-out! |work=[[Die Zeit]] |language=de |access-date=2026-07-11}}</ref>
